steps.title: Gather on the Usurper in the south
steps.cue: Usurper of Frost reappears south of the centre
steps.rule: Melee take her east and west flanks.

MainTank.rule: Tank her from the north side, 4m in front of her.

RegenHealer.rule: Wait north-west of her, 4m south-west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Wait north-east of her, 4m south-east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Wait north-west of her, near waymark 4.

CasterDps.rule: Wait north-east of her, near waymark 3.
